findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_copy, analyze_email, analyze_ad_stack, analyze_company, intelligence_index · Private data: analyze_copy, analyze_email, analyze_landing_page, analyze_funnel, analyze_ads, analyze_ad_stack, analyze_growth, analyze_company, analyze_competitors, compare_benchmark, ask, intelligence_index, kb_sectors, kb_search, kb_get, kb_examples, kb_benchmarks · Public sink: analyze_copy, analyze_email, analyze_ad_stack, intelligence_index, plan, kb_playbook · Destructive: analyze_ad_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_copy, analyze_email, analyze_ad_stack, analyze_company, intelligence_index · Private data: analyze_copy, analyze_email, analyze_landing_page, analyze_funnel, analyze_ads, analyze_ad_stack, analyze_growth, analyze_company, analyze_competitors, compare_benchmark, ask, intelligence_index, kb_sectors, kb_search, kb_get, kb_examples, kb_benchmarks · Public sink: analyze_copy, analyze_email, analyze_ad_stack, intelligence_index, plan, kb_playbook · Destructive: analyze_ad_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
